description: Prepare archives for new model names and distinguish configuration from trainer-code changes.
prompt: Review two proposed CTR variants before training. Both have new model names. Variant A changes only configuration; variant B also changes trainer source. The only published archive is s3://example-artifacts/builds/ctr_baseline-abc123.zip for the unchanged baseline trainer. The draft gives both variants version abc123 and submits them without publishing anything. Explain the required artifact preparation and how to avoid a missing-archive failure. This is a read-only planning/review task: inspect repository code as needed, but do not edit files, contact services, copy remote objects, or submit jobs.

judge_criteria: Explains that each new model name requires its own builds/{model_name}-{version}.zip even when the trainer bytes are identical.
For A, copies the unchanged archive to the verified new model name with the same abc123 content version rather than fabricating a new version or needlessly rebuilding.
For B, rebuilds and publishes the changed trainer and uses its actual content-derived version, rather than copying baseline bytes or reusing abc123 for different code.
Distinguishes trainer archive paths from models/{model_name}/{version} output/report paths and verifies the actual names/locations before publishing or submitting.
Notes that B changes trainer code as well as configuration, affecting controlled comparison interpretation; does not claim artifacts were published or training ran.
